title: Managing Microsoft Purview Going Forward — Operations & Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Run Microsoft Purview as an operated, measured compliance program
problem: Turning Purview on is the start; running it is where value (or drift) happens. This solution is the Purview operating model: a policy lifecycle (design→simulate→enforce→review), Compliance Manager improvement-action cadence, alert triage and reporting across DLP/labels/insider-risk/audit, periodic role and access reviews, change control, and the KPIs/dashboards that prove the program is healthy — so Purview stays effective, tuned, and defensible over time.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Purview operating model: policy lifecycle, Compliance Manager cadence, alerting/triage, reporting, role reviews, and change control.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (an implemented Purview foundation, roles, reporting data sources, governance stakeholders).

Operating Guide — stand up the policy lifecycle + change control, run the Compliance Manager improvement cadence, wire alert triage + reporting, schedule role/access reviews, and operate the KPI dashboards — each runbook named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Runbook Library + validation gates (policies reviewed, alerts triaged, roles reviewed, KPIs trending) plus Best Practices for a durable, measured Purview program.
short: Run Microsoft Purview as an operated program — policy lifecycle, Compliance Manager cadence, alert triage + reporting, role/access reviews, change control, and KPI dashboards — so Purview stays effective and defensible over time. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
